notes.title: NetherWorld is NOT Out Yet, but we're close!
notes.content: [h3][b][i]Hey Netherholics,[/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Today, Friday September 12, 2025, [b]NetherWorld was scheduled to be launched on both Steam and Nintendo Switch[/b] by the time of this update.[/p][p][/p][p]Well, we have [i][b]good news[/b][/i] and [i][b]not-that-good news[/b][/i]:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]GOOD NEWS:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]NetherWorld is out on [b]Nintendo Switch![/b] (digital and physical)[/p][/*][*][p][b]NetherWorld Steam build is ready[/b] to be played, but[b]*[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]*NOT-THAT-GOOD-NEWS:[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Although the game build is [b]ready since 2-3 weeks ago[/b] (press has already enjoyed it!), [b]we're having some issues with Steam final approval[/b] due to some necessary changes regarding [b]Steam page content[/b] (e.g. some additions to content warnings) rather than the build itself.[/p][/*][*][p][b]These requests were fulfilled the same day[/b], but the wait for Steam's approval exceeded our time expectations.[/p][/*][*][p]We fought all we could to maintain the release day and hour with the approval, but unfortunately it wasn't possible.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]We're so sorry for the inconvenience,[/b] and promise you're gonna play this sh*t as soon as Steam lets us![/p][p]We'll let you know any progress about this matter.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your patience![/p][p][/p][p]Hungry Pixel team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34097664/b784ecd582582f284fababcdfbf575b5fea43956.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #15
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey, Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3][p]
How are you?[/p][p align="start"]We've heard about a thing called "[i]summer vacation"...[/i] Is it food or something?[/p][p][/p][h3]All we know is that we've been cooking non-stop and [b]you're gonna eat delicious shit soon[/b], heeheehee... We'll be at[b] Hall 10.2., Stand F040-E057. [/b][/p][p align="start"]You'll be able to play 5 bosses and Tick Joe minigame too (and get a prize for playing!). [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34097664/27fb41f954621ebc9ff0510b310b39a3a3d19af6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]2)[/b] Kickstarter rewards for non-backers[/h1][p]We don't normally share here the status of our Kickstarter campaign rewards, but [b]NetherWorld's artbook[/b] is one we're considering selling in our Steam page digitally.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Artbook features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]It's a digital artbook (PDF).[/p][/*][*][p]It's in full-color.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Width:[/b][/i]  13,2 cm / 5.19 inches.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Length:[/b][/i] 16,2 cm / 2.36 inches.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Nº pages:[/b][/i] 32.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Language: [/b][/i]English, Spanish and Catalan (all versions included).[/p][/*][*][p][b]2 exclusive illustrated covers.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Would you consider buying it if sold digitally (PDF) in our Steam page? [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34097664/f8e3a966cea8994ae0a36744764ad1ba4053ff1a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you're one of our Kickstarter backers, here's an [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1522665641/netherworld-drugs-sex-and-pixels-adventure-game/posts/4448496"]extended update[/url] with more detailed rewards status!  [/p][p][/p][h1][b]3)[/b] Still working non-stop[/h1][p]Although [b]NetherWorld gold version is ready and fully tested for PC and Nintendo Switch[/b], we're still polishing the polishable so you can have [b]quick Day One / Day Two updates[/b] besides any bug you find while playing (the more people play it, the more probabilities to find a bug we didn't experienced during testing).[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]There's one bad thing tho: Unfortunately, [b]Mac and Linux versions of the game may not be available on Day One[/b] due to lack of enough hardware to test, export and update them properly. However, we know there's people who want to play these versions and we're doing all our best to have both builds ready as soon as we can. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Here's a screenshot of Gazhova's Church so we can all pray to Wormpink so everything can go smoothly:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34097664/d164f0e7c268faeb4beaef236d74fd2e541bc44e.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]3)[/b] Wishlist button for non-wishlisters[/h1][p] It's easy. It's cool. It fully prepares you for a crazy ride with a cokehead mage[b]*[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Add NetherWorld to your wishlist below![/i][/b] [/h3][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p][b]*[/b]Claim not contrastable.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png"][/img][/p][h3][i][b]Aaaaand that's it for now![/b][/i][/h3][p]How was it? We hope you enjoy our new Future Games Show's exclusive trailer on [b][url="https://www.youtube.com/live/ZVRK-bSdkjo" style="button" buttoncolor="#c81414"]tomorrow's live[/url][/b] (August 20)![/p][p][/p][p]As always, [u][b]thanks so much for your support![/b][/u]

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #14
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]HELL-o Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

How’s summer going? Please don’t die of heat stroke, [b]we’re near the 100% game development!![/b]

To prevent that (the stroke, not the full development), get in the elevulture(?) and join us in this [i]chill ride[/i] called “What We’ve Done”. [i][b]LET’S GOGO![/b][/i]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/nvfEDHS.mp4[/video]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]1)[/b] Events[/h1]

One of the greatest pros of having publisher has been the possibility to [b]travel to physical events outside our main city[/b] without going bankrupt, and also [b]joining more online events![/b]

Since March we’ve been to:

[h2]1.1) [url=https://guadalindie.com/]Guadalindie 2024[/url][/h2]
[h3]May 3-4 | Málaga (Spain)[/h3]

Its first edition automatically became a must event in Spain on the first semester of the year. Place, people, games, conferences... [b]All 10/10.[/b] Kudos to the amazing organization! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yosBGBP.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PA0vEVT.png[/img]

Thanks to our publisher [url=https://selecta-play.com/en/]Selecta Play[/url] we made one of our dreamt merchandise real: [b]Wormpink condoms![/b] 

[previewyoutube=Jp5D5lOwsWA;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyone who played the demo could have this [i][b]reward[/b][/i] by [b]putting their hand into a NetherWorlian popcorn bucket.[/b] Being a double-headed worm has its benefits: You could choose the hole! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6B5qJWJ.png[/img]

Sometimes people had to wait a bit to play, but nothing could stop them to get the reward anyway! You just had to wishlist the game and [b]play a ring toss[/b] sponsored by Neth Beer:

[previewyoutube=Vg_l_BGg5YI;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, this was our [b]most complete physical stand[/b] we’d had since IndieDevDay 2023. In fact, [b]we won the Best Stand Decoration Award![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2lB5qyj.png[/img]
[i]Celebrating the award with our friends from [url=https://x.com/halfsunkgames]Half Sunk Games[/url] (their game "[url=https://x.com/UpBl0w]Bl0w Up[/url]" won the "Most Brutal Award") and [url=https://x.com/ChumasGames]Chumas Games[/url] ("Best Puzzle Game" for his game "PANIK").[/i]


We also appeared in [b]different Spanish media[/b], as well as having a very interesting [url=https://npcsyndicate.com/la-locura-de-una-medusa-a-la-que-le-ha-dejado-su-mujer-los-pequenos-grandes-juegos-de-guadalindie/opinion/]interview with the good people of NPC Syndicate[/url] [i](Original source in Spanish. Feel free to check it out!).[/i]


[h2]1.2) IndiE3 2024[/h2]
[h3]June 4 | Online[/h3]

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #13
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

How are you? Spring entered the room with blossoms, and so did us with OSOM news!

[i][b]LET’S OPEN THE NOSTRILS![/b][/i] (eyes recommended too)


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]1)[/b] WE HAVE A PUBLISHER!![/h1]

YES.

YES-YES-YES. After months of negotiations, we’re happy to announce that [i][b]WE SIGNED A PUBLISHING DEAL WITH SELECTAPLAY![/b][/i] 

[previewyoutube=UNrzO5rqnLc;full][/previewyoutube]

For those who don’t know them (yet), [url=https://www.selecta-vision.com/selecta-play-new/]SelectaPlay[/url] is the video games publishing branch of SelectaVisión, a Spanish video publishing company with a huuuge catalog of anime and live-action feature films, TV shows, and movies. 

[i][b][h3]“Okay, cool!! …What does that mean?”[/h3][/b][/i]
Thanks to this agreement, SelectaPlay will bring us all their support and necessary resources for:
[list]
[*] NetherWorld’s [b]digital and physical publishing for Nintendo Switch and PC[/b];

[*] [b]Marketing and PR support[/b] before, during and after release;

[*] [b]Kickstarter rewards management[/b] (production and shipment).
[/list]

Not bad, huh? Oh, and one more thing:

[b][h3]WE HAVE AN ESTIMATED RELEASE DATE![/h3][/b]
As you may know, [b]NetherWorld’s development will finish this year[/b]. Our intention was to release it at the end of 2024, but both the team and SelectaPlay agreed that to ensure an ideal release campaign (+ great localization, decent QA, physical edition production, etc.) the best option for the game was to [b]move the launch date to 2025[/b].

What hurts us the most is the delay of the release date, and [b]we’d like to apologize for that[/b]. After all this rollercoaster of emotions called [i]Indie Dev Life[/i], you’ve kept showing us your support and patience, and we’re working to make this game worth the wait. [b]Thank you <3.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cTbvrUx.jpeg[/img]
[i]Visiting SelectaPlay’s headquarters a couple days ago![/i]

Can’t wait to show you some of the stuff we’ve started planning with them, [i]heheheheheheMUAHAHAHA...[/i]

Meanwhile, [b]you can follow SelectaPlay[/b] on any of their official community channels!

[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/SelectaPlay]Twitter Spain[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/SelectaPlayInt]Twitter International[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/selectaplay/]IG[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@selectaplay]YT[/url]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]2)[/b] Same Losers, New Look[/h1]

Maybe you noticed a little detail in the announcement video... Nope, there are no hidden Illuminati signs (this time), but we couldn’t make such a great announcement without suiting up! [b]Here’s our brand new logo as Hungry Pixel![/b]

[previewyoutube=P55e2-iSK7I;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]3)[/b] Wait... Not the same losers![/h1]

OK we lied, that logo is not the only new face in town:

[b][url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidlleida/]David Lleida[/url] has joined the team as Unity Developer[/b] to help us with the last steps of the game. He’s now focused on the remaining cinematics and ensuring everything works fine. [b]Welcome!! <3[/b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]4)[/b] From Backer To NPC[/h1]

As you may remember from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/672420?emclan=103582791463619072&emgid=3896241210470092476]our last update[/url], we started the process to fulfill the long-awaited Kickstarter "Dark Soul" backer tier reward: [b]Making their own NetherWorld NPC.[/b]

Well, we finished Phase 2 and… [b]Here are the HD dialogue portraits!! [/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tTZitoM.png[/img]
[i]Wanna see the pixel art animations too? We're considering showing them in next updates or waiting until you see them ingame.[/i]

Having support on cinematics has given us the chance to [b]keep improving details[/b] of the biggest urban areas like [b]Gazhova and Pinksburg[/b], such as:

[video]https://i.imgur.com/APYCd6E.mp4[/video]
[i]We were selling exclusive “drunk Medoo” keychains too! Want one? ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) [/i]

That’s why during the last month we’ve been working on two demos: a stand-visitor one (with bosses and Tick Joe's minigame), and a publisher one (with story content too). 

You guys seemed to enjoy (and suffer) the public demo! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TUT1gGF.png[/img]

Besides discovering new minor bugs in the bosses, we also noted down all your feedback. Inputs like [b]increasing Medoo's visibility in dark scenarios[/b] and [b]improving the "You need to reload, dude" visual feedback[/b] will be fixed for the final game for sure. Thank you!  


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #10
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

How are you? Since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/672420/view/3658649059265428777]our last update[/url] we’ve been quite low-profile on [url=https://twitter.com/NetherWorldGame]Twitter[/url] and other social media because we’re reaching game content we don’t wanna spoil. However, our quarterly updates are SACRED, so we’ll tell & show you everything we can. [i][b]LET’S GO![/b][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]1)[/b] Scenarios[/h1]

[h2]1.1) The too-religiously-invested organic cyberpunk capital[/h2]

We’ve spent nearly 2 months crafting [b]Pinksburg[/b], one of the biggest scenarios of the game.
We prefer waiting a bit more to show you Medoo getting lost in it, but most of its weird buildings are ready, so... Check out some of its designs!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nUG4elw.png[/img]
[i]Some Pinksburg buildings without neon signs. Quite huge![/i]


We have lots of NPCs too, especially the first designs of [b]The Mofia*[/b]: an organization that rules the city in the shadows. What are they up to?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fpWl4a8.png[/img]
[i]*Any resemblance to other criminal organizations called “Mafia” is pure coincidence. They're [b]mabs[/b], not mobs![/i]


We’re currently working on some interior scenarios like [b]a bar, an office, a two-level club, a hotel suite, Pinksburg Church[/b] (a new scenario inside the scenario) [b]and more![/b]

Once we finish the interiors and implement the upper level elevators, [b]we’ll add all the crazy neon signs and light effects everywhere.[/b]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/m5Sugl6.mp4[/video]
[i]Alpha light test for an elevator![/i]


[h2]1.2) Back to Gas City![/h2]

[b]Gazhova exterior surface is finished[/b], but there’s still some interiors to finish. We also [b]improved Sewers’ underground level parallax, adding depth[/b] and some [b]metal bridges[/b] so you can cross toxic acid rivers without harm.

[video]https://i.imgur.com/5TDrmvb.mp4[/video]
[i]Smelly jelly > Skelly jelly[/i]

[b]What's next for Gazhova?[/b] Implementing the elevator system that connects Surface and Sewers levels (after Pinksburg).


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]2)[/b] Bosses[/h1]

Thanks to Xavi, there’s only one last big boss to make… Yes, you guessed well: [b]The Final Boss!![/b]
After several weeks of design meetings to ensure the most epic and complete fight of the game, we’re glad to announce that [b]Boss #12 is starting production next week![/b] Any guesses?


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]3)[/b] Buggie Dance[/h1]

We found some time to [b]improve our demo for future physical events[/b] too [i](don’t ask how, we don’t even know)[/i]. Can’t confirm any yet but [b]our intention is to be in 2 events this year![/b]

Preparing this new demo allowed us to fix some [b]unexpected critical bugs[/b] like:

[list]
[*] [b]Some Tick Joe’s enemies trapped in walls.[/b]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/NUgvZc6.mp4[/video]
[i]This bug only appeared to Albert in almost every run. However, every time he wanted to film it with the screen recorder, it disappeared. He finally recorded it with the phone to prove he wasn't crazy.[/i]

[*] [b]Weird object breakability physics in Boss #4 (“Protect the milky creature”).[/b]

[*] [b]Phase 2 transition errors in Boss #9 (“Blue Fire Armor").[/b]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]4)[/b] Script[/h1]

Keeping a low profile in social media (and answering mails a bit later, sorry!) has allowed us to focus on writing at full throttle. [b]The first version of the script is at 80% now[/b], and our goal is to complete it by the end of June.

This way we’ll have all the summer to rewrite, cut filler and polish to achieve the [i][b]*[/b]cheff kiss[b]*[/b][/i] level (or trying it at least).


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]5)[/b] Music[/h1]

Meanwhile, [url=https://www.roguesonics.com/][b]Rogue Sonics[/b][/url] [b]have been on fire composing and producing a couple boss themes (#7 & #9) [/b]and the [b]drinking minigame track[/b] since January. They recently started with [b]Boss 9 SFX[/b] and [b]Pinskburg main theme[/b] too. Still on the works, but can’t wait to listen to it!

[video]https://i.imgur.com/q4z0hjv.mp4[/video]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]6)[/b] Pitches, Pitches, Pitches, Pitches-Pitches[/h1]

[b]We haven’t stopped sending pitches to publishers[/b] we think NetherWorld could fit in their catalog, but [b]for now we haven’t been lucky[/b]. However, we truly believe in our project and we’ll fight until last minute to find a partner that can make NetherWorld launch easier and reach as many people as possible.

Do you know any publisher that would be interested in NetherWorld? We're all ears! 
If not, you can do something too: 

[h3][b][i]Add NetherWorld to your Wishlist and be a part of this crazy journey![/i][/b][/h3] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]

[h3][i][b]Aaaaand that's it for now! How was it?[/b][/i][/h3] 
If you have any questions or insults, please comment below or send us a mail to [url=mailto:info@netherworldgame.com]info@netherworldgame.com[/url].


[u][b]Thanks so much for your support and see you in the next devblog! :)[/b][/u]

[b][i]Hungry Pixel team[/i][/b]

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #9
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

It’s us, or did February pass faster than January? Anyway, [b]how’s 2023 going?[/b]

[h3][i][b]THIS HAS BEEN OURS SO FAR:[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]1)[/b] Bosses[/h1]

As scheduled in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/672420/view/3627118151119565764]our last update[/url], [b]Boss #10 is finished![/b] There’s still visual stuff and minor bugs to polish, but we’re happy with the results. This time we’ve decided not showing screenshots [i](sorry! v.v)[/i], but for now let’s say it’s… [i][b]a drug lord[/b][/i]. (͠≖ ͜ʖ͠≖)

So… [b]Only 2 bosses ahead now![/b]
In the following months we’ll be discussing Boss #12's design. It’s the final one and [b]we want to make sure it’s [i]EPIC![/i][/b]

Hope we can tell (& show) you more soon without spoilers!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]2)[/b] New implementations[/h1]

[h2]2.1) Map location[/h2]

Can’t show footage yet, but [b]now you can see your location in the map![/b] It will also [b]change during the story[/b] while unlocking the different worms and discovering where the heck they lead to.


[h2]2.2) Minigame rewards[/h2]

Every time you finish a minigame, you’ll obtain items, money or both. Our idea was [b]items to pop up, and money to rain on you or going towards you.[/b] Visuals still WIP, but it works!

[video]https://i.imgur.com/WyVMmDD.mp4[/video]
[i]While testing it, we had the [b]great[/b] idea of setting a 3k coins reward. 2 minutes later, Medoo was still under the golden shower lol[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]3)[/b] Scenarios[/h1]

[h2]3.1) Gas City[/h2]

[b]Gazhova is 95% done[/b], as well as all its NPCs placed! [b]In the following weeks we’ll start building all the in-game cinematics and dialogues[/b], and also making sure everything (quests, minigames, NPCs, main story) works and looks cool.

[video]https://i.imgur.com/BiIx2T0.mp4[/video]
[i]Hanging around at Ikarov's sewer bar! (Visuals not final)[/i]


[h2]3.2) Building the Capital![/h2]

While our programmer Dan is focused on Gazhova, this March our artist Alex will be on fire with the [b]last big scenario: Pinksburg[/b]. It will be the 8th scenario of the game, and [b]NetherWorld's capital[/b].

How will it look like? Any guesses? Can’t wait to show you concepts and building designs in the coming updates!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]4)[/b] Business[/h1]

In the last 3 months we’ve been a bit less active on Social media [i](e.g. [url=https://twitter.com/NetherWorldGame]Twitter[/url])[/i] and even slowed down NetherWorld’s development a bit to deal with our [b]Boss #13: Paperwork[/b].

[video]https://i.imgur.com/Mb5yUZf.mp4[/video]

[b]The chance of a publisher agreement or just selling our game as a set up studio has demanded our attention[/b], implying business & economic plans and budgets considering all the possible scenarios.

As a small indie team with very limited resources, [b]we’d like to thank [url=https://www.barcelonactiva.cat/en/home]Barcelona Activa[/url] for their free assessment[/b] in business creation and financial stuff to avoid jail and bankruptcy in the future :')


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]5)[/b] What's ahead[/h1]

[h2]5.1) Unblocking Part 1[/h2]

It’s taking more time than expected, but [b]we continue working to make sure the first 60% of the game (main and secondary content) is fully playable without any critical or major bugs.[/b] It’s a kinda slow process but [i][b]we’re getting closer to the finish line![/b][/i]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/BtdZLuw.mp4[/video]


[h2]5.2) Writing Part 2[/h2]

Not gonna lie: Writing a script while handling other necessary tasks is hard, and burnout ghosts are there. However, [b]having all the scenes planned makes us confident and glad about the direction the script is going.[/b]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/9dNf3Sl.mp4[/video]


[h2]5.3) WANTED: Publishers[/h2]

We haven’t stopped sending pitches and scheduling meetings. [b]If you know any publishers that may be interested in NetherWorld, make them know![/b]


[h2]5.4) WANTED: You[/h2]
Our sensors detected in your eyes a high amount of [i]WISH[/i] to play the game, but... Is it in the [i]LIST[/i]? [b]Help us and add it below![/b] [i](Thanks <3)[/i]  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h3][i][b]Aaaaand that's it for now! How was it?[/b][/i][/h3]

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #8
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

How are you? These last 3 months have been [b]CRAZY[/b], and we wanted to share with you all this craziness in a final 2022 update!

[h3][i][b]LET’S GO-hO-hO![/b][/i][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]1)[/b] New Artwork and Trailer[/h1]

As we told you in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/672420/view/3291591738141634199]September’s update[/url], [b]we had the cool chance to have a physical stand at the 5th edition of IDD22[/b], an awesome indie game development event held in Barcelona (Spain). So... It was time to update our visual materials everywhere, and we’re very glad of the results!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zev5rRJ.png[/img]
[i]Amazing work by our artist [url=https://alefarfer.artstation.com/projects]Alex Fariña[/url].[/i]


We made a [b]new trailer[/b] too:
[previewyoutube=Kha0qqZK6EQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Did you like it? [b]Let us know your thoughts![/b]

We also created a [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJDI1UjMjUGFpWHDDoR8nug][b]new Youtube channel[/b][/url] that will contain all NetherWorld and Hungry Pixel-related content from now on. Feel free to subscribe to it!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]2)[/b] IndieDevDay 2022 Experience[/h1]

[b]What an amazing weekend. [/b]We’re extremely happy and grateful for meeting incredible devs, some of our Kickstarter backers, as well as for the hundreds of people who came by, talked to us and played the bosses demo (we even had a waiting line WTF).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tvvmWB8.png[/img]

We were also interviewed by Spanish indie game media such as [url=https://youtu.be/UOf1qS8RifA?t=871][b]XYZ Reviews[/b][/url] or [url=https://youtu.be/zdWSG_3bjSU?t=849][b]El Ático Indie[/b][/url]! (Very nice people btw)

[b]Here’s some photos of the event[/b] (in case you couldn't come and want to add yourself with Photoshop):

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WJTZYrf.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qrOwOgm.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sbQeTvH.png[/img]
[i]Xavi (boss programmer) and Albert (communications, writer) after a  whole non-stop event weekend. Smiling outside, dead inside.[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]3)[/b] New Improvements and Implementations[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Vendor system:[/b]
Fully tested and coordinated with the buying, inventory and money systems.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2fGidnB.png[/img]
[i]UI design and text not final.[/i]

[*] [b]Barman system:[/b]
A variation of the vendor system that allows you to order drinks and food, as well as taking part in drinking tournaments.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LWZfWAN.gif[/img]
[i]UI design and text not final... hip![/i]

[*] [b]Mission system:[/b]
That includes checking current main and secondary quests, automatic crossed-out + pop up for the ones you already made, subtasks list, expanded descriptions, etc.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WJkNSwG.png[/img]
[i]UI design and text not final.[/i]

[*] [b]Playing 60% of the game non-stop:[/b]
We’ve been fixing bugs to make sure all the developed game and quests are playable uninterruptedly. At some parts of the game, you’ll be able to [b]choose between different main quests[/b], and we have to be sure nothing breaks despite the quest you chose first.
[/list]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]4)[/b] Bosses[/h1]

As always, our boss programmer Xavi has done an amazing job developing Boss #9/12. For those who played the first demo of NetherWorld, [b]this boss is a (more?) surreal adaptation of the Blue Fire Armor.[/b] Its design was updated both narratively and mechanically to fit the final version of the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7joiGKG.png[/img]
[i]Old "Blue Fire Armor" boss.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6FysbhY.png[/img]
[i]New (and mostly hidden) "Blue Fire Armor" boss.[/i]

Regarding to [b]Boss #10[/b], it’s currently in the works and planned to be ready the first weeks of 2023!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]

[b]Gazhova (Gas City)[/b] has been quite a challenge due to its size: [b]Not only horizontally, but also vertically[/b] (it has 2 levels, 3 in some areas). That’s why it has taken up most of Alex’s time, dreams and nightmares. The good news are that [b]remaining NPCs are done[/b], and the [b]scenario is planned to be fully finished in the following weeks.[/b]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/XZtb44o.mp4[/video]
[i]We were so focused on streetlights, that we forgot to implement the correct access to the Sewer level. HOWEVER, you can technically go to the Sewer level now, right?[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]6)[/b] What's Ahead[/h1]

2023 is especial for us. Main reason? [b]We’re committed (and scheduled) to have NetherWorld FINALLY finished that year[/b] [i](yeeaah!)[/i].

We have the last big scenario ahead, along with the final boss, the final scenes scripts and the final final everything. [b]IDD22 and all your support really gave us renewed energies to face the last year of development with confidence.[/b] We really hope you enjoy the crazy shit we’re doing!!

[video]https://i.imgur.com/wDBt6KW.mp4[/video]
[i]Eating mushrooms in Fornus Forest is high-ly recommended.[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h3][i][b]Aaaaand before finishing...[/b][/i][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PbTqoFA.png[/img]

Unlike Medoo, we'd like to
[h3][i][b]wish you a Merry Christmas and a Grrreat 2023! :D[/b][/i][/h3]


[u][b]Thanks so much for your support, get wasted responsibly and see you next year![/b][/u]

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #7
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

All good? How was your sweaty vacation?
If you feel a [i]gentle breeze[/i] in the back of your necks, enjoy: [i]IT'S US BLOWING YOU COOL NEWS![/i][b]*[/b]

[b]*[/b](if you feel it twice, it's not us. Get the hell outta there.)

[h3][i][b]LET’S SEE WHAT WE GOT![/b][/i][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]1)[/b] IndieDevDay 2022[/h1]

For the first time in centuries, we’re glad to announce [b]we’ll have a physical stand in the [url=https://www.indiedevday.es/en/]IndieDevDay 2022[/url] event on October 29 & 30![/b]

For those who didn’t know about it, [b]IDD[/b] is an [b]indie game development event[/b] held in Barcelona (Spain). This 5th edition is sponsored by the publisher Devolver Digital, and will have [b]tons of meetups, workshops, conferences, indie game stands and more![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p8nOyv9.jpg[/img]
[i]You'll be able to meet us, kick us and also play the improved boss beta our Kickstarter backers tested! (1/3 actions may not be possible)[/i]

If you’re in Barcelona during these days, [b]feel free to come by![/b] (Entrance is literally [i][b]free[/b][/i]).


[i][b]**[/b]In case you are a horrible person who lives abroad and don’t want to spend a fortune in transport (how dare you!), no worries: [b]we’ll have a virtual stand in the event website too![/b][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]2)[/b] New Footage and Materials[/h1]

Having this event in mind, [b]we’ve worked hard to prepare and update every footage and material[/b] we can to show the game as it looks now. That means:

[list]
[*] [b]New trailer[/b]
[*] [b]Website content update[/b]
[*] [b]Steam page content update[/b]
[/list]
We’ll reveal everything once the event date is closer. [b]CAN'T WAIT FOR YOU TO SEE IT![/b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDxMKDw.png[/img]
[h1][b]3)[/b] Development Progress[/h1]

Besides the event preparation, [b]NetherWorld’s development has continued flowing[/b] like a summer day sweat dripping down our armpits:

[h2]3.1) More Bosses![/h2]

[b]Bosses #7 and #8 are fully playable[/b], but there’s still work to do regarding to final animations.

[list]
[*] [b]Boss #7[/b] will include a puzzle-solving mechanic and a unique weapon. Here’s how the scenario will look like! [i][WIP][/i]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CV9Rybh.png[/img]
[list]

[*] [b]Boss #8[/b] is a nearly [b]total rework and improvement of the Abbess[/b] we showed in the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1522665641/netherworld-drugs-sex-and-pixels-adventure-game?ref=417359&token=7f9332a2]original Kickstarter campaign[/url]. That includes [b]explosive fetuses and tons of blood[/b], of course.
[/list]

We’ll show you more once we have the final assets!


[h2]3.2) More Buildings![/h2]

The [b]Gas City of Gazhova[/b] has several important structures, including the [b]Old Church[/b]. We’ve finally finished its exterior, and [b]this is how its top wormlight looks like! [/b]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/Bs8pZRA.mp4[/video]
[i]Wanna see the rest of it? [b]Wait for the trailer! ;)[/b][/i]


[h2]3.3) More Particles![/h2]

Travelling to a toxic city like Gazhova means [b]there’s deadly gas everywhere[/b], so [b]we’ve been testing different gas particles[/b] to set the mood.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NwDL6ZJ.png[/img]
[i]Don’t forget the gas mask in the city![/i]


We’ve also added [b]dust and snow particles[/b] to the desert and snow scenarios:

[video]https://i.imgur.com/Jt8DNft.mp4[/video]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/6F3GuK2.mp4[/video]


[h2]3.4) More Fixing![/h2]

Preparing new materials for October’s IndieDevDay hasn’t stopped us from the usual game development. That involved [b]fixing and improving stuff like:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Tick Joe minigame minor bugs[/b]
[*] [b]Zoom system for specific locations and cinematics:[/b]
We managed to avoid pixel deformations due to resolution, zoom scale, pixel perfect grid or others.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mLJwiwj.png[/img]
[i]For some, the solution was to stop applying interpolation based on screen size. For others, changing the bulb.[/i]

[*] [b]Alcohol (and/or other) effects for every drink[/b] depending on type and number. Food effects too! 
[*] [b]Buying system design implementation.[/b]
[*] [b]Excessive slippery terrains:[/b]
Medoo is clumsy, but not THAT clumsy.
[*] [b]New Autonomous Bird behavior system:[/b]
Footage soon!
[*] [b]Controls changes:[/b]
“Draw weapon” and “Change selection from multiple objects” keys are separate now.
[*] [b]“Conditional Equipped Object” system standardization:[/b]
Depending on the hat or/and mask you’re wearing -or the object you have in the inventory-, you’ll be able to start or complete missions. Even getting into exclusive places!


[*] [b]Strange bug in your Steam account:[/b]
That caused not having NetherWorld in your wishlist, but you can fix it easily by clicking the following awesome button! 
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #6
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

If summer vibes haven’t reached you yet, you’ll feel them now, honey. [i][b]HERE WE GO![/b][/i]

[video]https://i.imgur.com/KREH7hG.mp4[/video]

[i]Taking attendance at the Worm Cave. [/i]

Although Tick Joe underground adventures are one of our most advanced minigames, we were still using old or generic assets for the dungeons… [b]UNTIL NOW![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PaXFIzZ.png[/img]

notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]


Hope you’re all fine. Oh, you’re not? Don’t worry, we bring good stuff to fix that!

[i]Medoo, light up the room and [b]LET’S GO!![/b][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/swTz2jU.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/juHBEf2.png[/img]
[h1]DEWORMCRATIC ELECTION RESULTS[/h1]

A month ago we asked our Kickstarter backers which [b]double-headed worm model[/b] they preferred to puke them (and you too) around NetherWorld scenarios.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/111fCYw.png[/img]
[i]Hmmm... Parabolic A, Punky B or Mustaches C?[/i] 

[b]AND THE PEOPLE SPOKE:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5k6Mogo.png[/img]

[h3]CONGRATS TO PARABOLIC A! 👏👏👏[/h3] 

[b]We wanna thank our incredible backers again for voting and giving us feedback.[/b] We also noticed people liked B a lot (it even won the Twitter poll!), so MAYBE we manage to include it one way or another.

We also promised we’d show the winner’s main animations [b]you'll see when travelling from a scenario to the Worm Cave[/b] (vomiting / absorbing effects will be added soon):

[img]http://i.imgur.com/813FSU6.gif[/img]

However, this is only the basic model. [b]The final design of each worm will change a bit depending on the scenario they are placed on[/b] (or lead to). We really hope you like it!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/juHBEf2.png[/img]
[h1]SCENARIOS: UPDATES & UPGRADES[/h1]

We’re glad to announce that [b]all the scenarios from the first 60% of the game are playable.[/b] Some of them have a new look too! (no lightning or particles yet).

[h2]1) [b]New Mordisco Desert[/b][/h2]

In order to [b]make it feel eerier and threatening[/b], we decreased saturation, changed sky color and tested increasing mountains size (so they looked closer to the player). We'll add [b]sandstorm particles[/b] in the future.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U6RFr0t.png[/img]

We also fixed the scale of some houses that made Medoo look way taller than he really is:

[list]
[*][b]Old Saloon size:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Db7d2Dt.png[/img]
[i]"Optimistic Medoo", 2020. Oil on canvas.[/i]
[/*]
[*][b]New Saloon size:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XUDXxdh.png[/img]
[i]"Realistic Medoo", 2021. Tears on canvas.[/i]
[/*]
[/list]
[h2]2) [b]New forest[/b][/h2]

Fornus Forest was one of the first areas we created on 2016, and despite some upgrades it was looking too old. We decided to burn most of it and plant [b]new assets in a completely new terrain.[/b] SLOPES EVERYWHERE!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wSZfYa4.gif[/img]

We’ve also improved some of the creature designs:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5hcBvwL.gif[/img]

Whether you get lost or wanna have fun in Fornus, we encourage you to visit this spot. It’s empty now, but [b]keep reading to know who you’ll find there.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7T3XUns.gif[/img]

[h2]3) [b]Home, S-weed Home[/b][/h2]

We’ve made [b]Medoo’s house bigger, and with more rooms and objects.[/b] Besides... It will change [i][b]a bit [/b][/i]during the story!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5htdgxQ.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/juHBEf2.png[/img]
[h1]CHARACTERS: UPDATES & UPGRADES[/h1]

Scenarios aren’t the only ones with a new face. Check out some of the [b]big changes we’ve done to main and secondary characters![/b]

[h2]1) [b]Bozky[/b][/h2]

notes.title: NetherWorld Devblog #1
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]
[h3][i]How are you?[/i][/h3]

We can all agree that 2020 sucked a bit, right?
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jXY7fnK.gif[/img]

In our case, we kinda survived the first half of the year, and even posted a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/672420/view/5262975441872295764]complete two-part recap about NetherWorld's last years of development[/url] on September 2020.

Did you read it? Are up to date? Great. [b]NOW FORGET IT.[/b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/MzNc936.png[/img]
[h1]THE ACCIDENT[/h1]

One month after the recap update, [b]NetherWorld scenarios were seriously damaged[/b] by a repository error.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/00RhdGu.png[/img]

An old [i].gitignore[/i] configuration had been ignoring most of the scenarios [i].meta[/i] files. This means that when we pulled a previous backup version to undo a minor game error, NetherWorld scenarios (including everything placed on them like cinematics, NPCs and the rest of visual elements) [b]were overwritten both in local and cloud[/b] with the [MostlyNothing.meta] saved in the backup. OH BOI.

We spent several days and nights trying to restore the original files, but it wasn't possible.

Despite the bad news and our temporary mental breakdown, there were reasons to be optimistic: [b]Dialogue script was fine[/b], [b]game code was fine[/b], and [b]visual assets as individual files were fine[/b] too. That meant we still had all the pieces of each scenario, and our job during the following months would focus on putting them together again (as well as working on new assets).


[img]https://i.imgur.com/MzNc936.png[/img]
[h1]WHEN LIFE GIVES YOU LEMONS[/h1]

[h2]1) [b]Technical upgrades[/b][/h2]

That unfortunate event made us realize there were several parts of the game that could be improved, but we couldn’t due to the structure of a game that was started on 2016. So [b]we had a last chance to apply all our gained experience during these years[/b] to upgrade old code, optimize functionalities and use new tools that [b]would speed NetherWorld up and make the future development easier.[/b]

Here’s all we’ve achieved since then:

[list]
[*][b]Backup system improvement:[/b]
We learnt the lesson, so we updated and tripled our protocols.[/*]
[*][b]Ranged weapon selection system improvement: [/b]
Easier for you to switch weapons during fights, easier for us to create new ones.[/*]
[*][b]New recoil system[/b][/*]
[*][b]New aiming system[/b][/*]
[*][b]New crouching system:[/b]
More agile and useful during fights.[/*]
[*][b]New falling system:[/b]
Shoot while falling and standing up![/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EIl4zms.gif[/img]

[*][b]Parallax System optimization[/b][/*]
[*][b]New UI system:[/b]
Way more optimized and in HD![/*]
[*][b]Pixel perfect system implementation:[/b]
We were doing it by hand![/*]
[*][b]Resolution optimization:[/b]
We added extra pixels to make it full native and scalable. Same resolution quality, less resources used, no half pixels. That also allows getting rid of external tools for pixel rotation.[/*]
[*][b]Item equipment system optimization:[/b]
Especially for hats and masks.[/*]
[*][b]Collider and trigger system improvement:[/b]
Using Unity’s physics and trigger systems at the same time was quite tricky for the project, so we created our own trigger system from scratch.[/*]
[*][b]Save and load system improvement:[/b]
We’ve adjusted (& optimized) it to follow all Nintendo Switch requirements.[/*]
[*][b]Game notification system improvement:[/b]
It was used for missions only, but now it works with in-game tutorials of any kind, shape and format.[/*]
[*][b]New cinematic engine:[/b]
Using Unity’s tool Timeline for cinematics instead of coding everything allows us to speed up their production without sacrificing narrative quality.[/*]
[*][b]New cinematic camera system:[/b]
Cool real time in-game cinematics need great camera fx, movements, and zooms! We made sure all of them work well with the pixel perfect system.[/*]
[*][b]NPC portraits on dialog interface:[/b]
With the HD UI upgrade, we’ll be able to see all NPCs and characters we talk to with more details than a few pixels![/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lVYPmza.png[/img]
[i]As you may suspect, dialog UI and Bozky's HD photo are not final.[/i]

[*][b]New controller plugin for Nintendo Switch[/b][/*]
[*][b]Slope system implementation:[/b]
See ya, plain scenarios! We’ve also fixed some bugs that didn’t allow NPCs to walk on these new irregular terrains.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/K1ZeX5x.png[/img]

[*][b]Multiselection:[/b]
Sometimes it was quite tricky to interact with the right objects or people because they were very close to each other. Not gonna happen again, baby.[/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sk192ny.gif[/img]
[i]Sorry for the GIF compression... Barman Bobb is ugly, but not THAT ugly.[/i]

[*][b]Drug effects system:[/b]
Every drug you drink, snort, eat or take somehow will have a different visual effect![/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JlGpneZ.gif[/img]
[i]Drunk who?[/i]

[*][b]Interacting from behind:[/b]
No more need to be in front of an NPC to start conversation![/*]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aHUP2IW.gif[/img]

[*][b]New Wishlist button:[/b]
Okay, it's not new... but if you press it you'll have all the good luck our protagonist lacks.[/*]
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420

[h2]2) [b]New artist in the team![/b][/h2]

Pandemic and confinement have affected us in many ways, not only at work but in our personal lives too. Due to personal reasons (basically LIFE), our incredible and talented artist [b]Isa asked us to step aside from the project[/b]. As a little family who has been working together for nearly 3 years, [b]that’s tough[/b]. However, the nº1 priority for us at Hungry Pixel is health (mental and physical).

But don't worry, [b]Isa is not leaving the studio![/b] We love her, we’ll miss her, and we wish she can come back for the next Hungry Pixel game with recharged batteries! <3

Not gonna lie, it was very difficult to find someone who could continue Isa’s amazing work. After many weeks and interviews... [b]WE DID IT[/b].

We’re glad to introduce you [b][u][url=https://alefarfer.artstation.com/projects]Alejandro Fariña[/url][/u][/b], NetherWorld’s new Main Artist!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ioyGyCM.png[/img]
Look at him... What is he hiding behind that smile? Let’s see what this guy can do!


[h2]3) [b]New scenarios[/b][/h2]

Wait… Did somebody say [b]NEW SCENARIOS[/b]? In plural?

[h3]>> [b]SNEW SNOW[/b][/h3]

We already had old snow assets from before starting our 2018’s Kickstarter campaign, but they needed to be upgraded to maintain the current visual quality of the game. Here's some of the changes!

[list]
[*][h3][b][i]Old Snow:[/i][/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k95va4m.png[/img]
[/*]

[*][h3][b][i]Upgraded Snow:[/i][/b][/h3]
[i](Still WIP / no effects / no sky)[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/50OsgPk.png[/img]
[i]Note to self: Don't lick the wall.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WUabfRp.png[/img]
[/*]
[*][h3][b][i]Stalkers of all kinds:[/i][/b][/h3]

In this freezing wasteland you’ll meet disturbing creatures like this dirty old man…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d2Rqhdo.gif[/img]


…or the official[b][u] Stalkers[/u][/b], one-eyed creepy fellas that live in tribes along the ice wall. Well, technically they live IN the wall. People call them stalkers because… [b][u]y’know.[/u][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qQSErYR.gif[/img]
[/*]
[/list]

[h3]>> [b]BROKEN BRIDGE[/b][/h3]

Broken Bridge is literally a [b][u]bridge between 3 scenarios:[/u][/b]

It connects with the Snow Scenario vertically, and the Forest (left) and Gas City (right) horizontally.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cUdPaRV.png[/img]
[i]Broken Bridge preliminary design.[/i]


Gas City was once home of the finest inventors and engineers, and that’s shown even before entering its gates:

[list]
[*][h3][b][i]Wanna go up?[/i][/b][/h3]

Visit the ice wall with the latest technology in elevators!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RjDRJxD.gif[/img]
[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b][i]Wanna go in?[/i][/b][/h3]

You’ll need a gas mask to enter Gas City, sir. If not, these wonderful city soldiers wearing ultimate camouflage uniforms will bar your way:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZWcZfKu.gif[/img]



We’re really proud of [b]Gas City Gates [/b]too. Hope you like them!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/09AVaMv.png[/img]
[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3][b][i]Meeting Sarah[/i][/b][/h3]

Sarah was once member of Gas City’s special operations unit, and now a [b]mutilated exiled living in a mass grave.[/b] She will have a VERY important role in the story.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ECs81ZL.gif[/img]
[/*]
[*][h3][b][i]“Hmmm… There’s something fishy about this bridge…”[/i][/b][/h3]

You’ll have to cross Broken Bridge several times for many reasons. Maybe the [b]Fisherman[/b] can help you out with some of them…
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sMHopQp.gif[/img]
[/*]
[/list]
[h2]4) [b]Reassembling old scenarios[/b][/h2]

As you know, one of the main priorities these months was to [b]rebuild the scenarios[/b] we already had before [i]The Accident[/i]: [b]Deumanville[/b] and [b]Mordisco Desert[/b]. Thanks to the [b]great art production rhythm[/b] finishing the Snow and Broken Bridge assets, we’ve been able to [b]improve stuff from the “old” scenarios[/b] too (and also [b]adding new assets[/b] that were pending).


[h3]>> [b]DEUMANVILLE[/b] [i](still WIP)[/i][/h3]

Medoo’s hometown has experienced several changes due to [b]slope system implementation[/b], [b]new skies[/b] (both night storm and sunset), [b]new rain particles[/b] and also [b]visual upgrades[/b] for the grass, trees and mountains (some colors may change in the future).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jf4Emfd.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][h3][b][i]Hanging out with neighbors[/i][/b][/h3]

One of the things we hadn’t added yet in the previous versions were [b]graves[/b]. NetherWolians have the tradition of hanging their deceased love ones. The higher the corpse, the easier for Wormpink to see it from above, eat its soul and puke it into the Holy Swamp.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TTeAQrt.gif[/img]
[/*]
[/list]
In the next update we’ll talk about the upgrades we’re doing to Mordisco Desert!


[h2]5) [b]Going Down The Tick's Hole[/b][/h2]

Anything related to [b][i]Tick Joe[/i][/b] deserves its own section. Here’s some of the [b]termite-mound-like entrances[/b] that will allow you to [b]play Tick Joe’s minigames[/b]! Each scenario will have its own design.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z36kRe9.png[/img]

[i]Some Tick Joe minigame entrances (left to right): standard, snow scenario, Deumanville.[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/MzNc936.png[/img]
[h1]NEXT STEPS[/h1]

[b]We have most of NetherWorld's first part assets ready[/b], so now we're focusing our work on assembling them all scenario by scenario, as well as working on the in-game real time cinematics. That's by far the part that takes more time, but we're optimistic about the whole development progress. 


[h3][b][i]Add NetherWorld to your Wishlist and join us in this crazy journey![/i][/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MzNc936.png[/img]

[h3][i][b]Aaaand that's it for now![/b][/i][/h3] 
If you have any questions, please comment below or send us a mail to [url=mailto:info@netherworldgame.com]info@netherworldgame.com[/url].


As always, [u][b]thanks so much for your support, stay safe and see you in the next devblog![/b][/u]

[b][i]Hungry Pixel team[/i][/b]

notes.title: Development Recap #2
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

How was your week? Did you like our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/672420/announcements/detail/5262975441872295765]first update[/url]? Well, we’re glad to say that once you read this second one, [b]you’ll be totally catch up[/b] with the current NetherWorld development! 

Today we’ll talk about [b]3 more scenarios[/b], the [b]teleport system[/b], a [b]new boss[/b], a [b]new minigame[/b] and more! 

Shit wait, disclaimers coming...
[h3][b]WARNING:[/b][/h3]NetherWorld is still under development, and this is a recap. Most footage and information shown here may be outdated or may change in the future to guarantee the best quality and fun. 
[h3][b]WARNING 2:[/b][/h3]GIF compression quality is worse than in-game real footage (sorry!). 
[h3][b]WARNING 3:[/b][/h3] Keep reading... and ENJOY! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/huB4jgy.png[/img]

Enough introductory blah blah blah. [i][b]LET’S START![/b][/i]

[b][h2][u]SCENARIOS (II)[/u][/h2][/b]
[h3][b]1. Mordisco Desert[/b][/h3]

Just like Deumanville, [b]the desert scenario[/b] has experienced important changes during the development. Two of the main reasons were the color contrast problems and excess particles of its first design. Here’s how the new version looks:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IV9RFMn.png[/img]
[i]"Why the fuck is this gif not moving...?"[/i]


The [b]inspiration[/b] for this scenario was clearly [b]Sergio Leone's spaghetti western movies[/b] ([i]"A Fistful of Dollars"[/i], [i]"For a Few Dollars More"[/i], [i]"The Good, the Bad and the Ugly"[/i]...). We're huge fans of them (especially Dan, our programmer), and we're deeply in love with their incredible OST composed by the ethernal [b]Ennio Morricone[/b] (R.I.P.).

Our amazing composers[b] Rogue Sonics have created an original soundtrack with these western vibes[/b] too. Can't wait for you to listen to it!

Mordisco Desert is also [b]one of the largest scenarios[/b], and includes different sub-scenarios you’ll be able to explore as well:

[h3][i][list]
[*]The Nachos Hideout
[/list][/i][/h3]

A western-inspired scenario is not complete without outlaws riding horses. But [b]who are they?[/b] Let’s dip into [b]The Nachos[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tp5WGkm.gif[/img]

[i][b]Guacco[/b][/i], [i][b]Cheddy[/b][/i], [i][b]Ketch[/b][/i] and [i][b]Mayo[/b][/i] will be the first people you’ll find in Mordisco. Maybe they can help you coming back home… 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hANIXdS.gif[/img]
[i]This is why Cheddy goes on a cart.[/i]


Medoo will find them during his hangover walk through an infinite hot-as-hell desert. [b]What do you think about their hideout?[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QWg7mCI.png[/img]

You’ll be able to [b]explore the inside too[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xvxAZkp.gif[/img]

This place is special for us due to many reasons:
[list]
[*] It’s the first place you’ll discover important [b]NetherWorld lore[/b].
[*] It’s a moment to tell and listen to stories, to delve into each [b]character background[/b]… And to drink, obviously.
[*] We’ve put a lot of effort into the illumination and sfx to make the place feel [b]comfy and real[/b].
[/list]


[h3][i][list]
[*]Saloon
[/list][/i][/h3]

We're happy to introduce you one of the many NetherWorld bars to [b]play drinking minigames[/b], ordering stuff to get drunk alone or just talking to weird people.

It has evolved [b]from a squared 3D zenithal view to a 2D side-scrolling view[/b]. Why? Time and resources, basically… It was impossible to make all the bars following this design. 

Bye, [b]Old Saloon[/b]:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U4YgSzt.gif[/img]

Hi, [b]New Saloon[/b] (WIP):

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VD4ogMw.gif[/img]

And here’s how the Saloon looks like from outside:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SYPgZ14.gif[/img]
[i]Hmmm… Something makes us suspect these guys are not from this town.[/i]


[h3][i][list]
[*]Sheriff Office
[/list][/i][/h3]

No description needed. Sooner or later, Medoo will end up there...
  
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gvc5rLC.gif[/img]

...because [b][i]Sheriff Westwood[/i][/b], aka “The Fucking Law”, will make sure of that.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oQT2KH9.gif[/img]

As you can see, [b]we changed his design[/b] to look more badass. After all, he's the bigwig of The Puke, Mordisco's biggest town.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zK89tJl.gif[/img]


[h3][i][list]
[*]Ammoizing Gun shop
[/list][/i][/h3]

Besides [b]obtaining weapons through main story quests and as rewards[/b], you’ll be able to purchase new ones talking to the correct NPC. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3gOIjpU.png[/img]
[i]“Howdy, stranger! Wanna get some shotguns?”[/i]


[h3][i][list]
[*]Wormpink Chapel
[/list][/i][/h3]

This old chapel was built long ago by [b][i]Wormy Olesva[/i][/b] to spread the word about Wormpink and the Great Abbess, and includes a cemetery inside. Oh, boy… [b]You’ll remember this place.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KVLmIjx.gif[/img]
[i]Wormpink Chapel from outside.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o1O9wBr.gif[/img]
[i]Wormy Olesva. [/i]


[h3][b]2. Fornus Forest[/b][/h3]

We wanted Fornus to be a [b]creepy[/b], [b]dark[/b] and [b]more mysterious version[/b] of a [i]"Princess Mononoke"[/i] forest. However, we had a handicap: Medoo was completely black, and although he'd have a torch to walk around there,[b] the scenario needed more illumination[/b].

So yeah, Fornus Forest hasn’t escaped from improvements neither (we’re still working on it tho).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vi1NtWt.gif[/img]
[i]Fornus Forest before / after some improvements. 
[/i]

Not all the elements in the scenario are just decoration. Feeling down? [b]Get high with those purple mushrooms! [/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D6rOZDg.gif[/img]


[b][h2][u]TELEPORT SYSTEM: Wormholes[/u][/h2][/b]

One of the main mechanics in the game is a fast way to travel between scenarios. Portals? Nah…
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hG7ZP0n.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DZSQ2Fz.png[/img]
[i]Wormpink and teleport worms first sketches.[/i]


Legend has it that [b]Wormpink[/b], the Life Puker, The Soul Eater, created everything. It’s basically a [b]holy giant two-headed pink worm[/b].

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/9n4GKwq.png[/img]

Maybe you won’t know if this god exists, but you’ll find normal (?) palindrome worms in most of the scenarios you visit. The mechanics are simple:[b] One head eats something somewhere, the other pukes it somewhere else[/b], and vice versa. Now replace “[b]something”[/b] with [i][b]“YOU”[/b][/i]. 

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/qj9DSBk.gif[/img]

But [b]where do all these surface worms lead to?
[/b]


[h3][i][list]
[*]Into the Unkworm: Neil's Cave
[/list][/i][/h3]

The [b]Worm Cave[/b], obviously! More than 5 worms are waiting to be unlocked using different items. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OYSP1Gi.png[/img]

We’re still testing the eat-and-puke mechanics (the worm of the picture is not final!), so hope in the following updates we can show you all the teleportation stuff. Trust us: The wait’s gonna be [b]totally wormth it![/b]


[h3][i][list]
[*]Meet the Zoontist
[/list][/i][/h3]

You won't be alone in the Worm Cave. It’s a scientist? It’s a creepy animal lover? No, [b]IT’S BOTH![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SFBjVH5.gif[/img]

[i][b]Neil[/b][/i] was the first Netherwolian to survive wormhole travelling, but at a high cost. After more than 20 years trapped in this cave, he’ll see Medoo as the help he needs to finally complete his research.


[b][h2][u]BOSSES (II)[/u][/h2][/b]

Mordisco Desert has its own threats, including this friend below. 

[h3][i][list]
[*]Keranukk
[/list][/i][/h3]

Run away from a [b]giant fast-as-fuck creature[/b] while throwing everything you find in the desert: rocks, barrels, babies…  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mkvjVAb.gif[/img]
[i]Run, Medoo... Run![/i]


[b][h2][u]MINIGAMES (II)[/u][/h2][/b]

In the last update we introduced Tick Joe rogue-like dungeons. This time we’ll show you one Mordisco minigame: [b]Shooting stuff while horse riding like an outlaw![/b] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7DUVcqb.gif[/img]
[i]As you can imagine, the game won’t be that easy.[/i]


[b][h2][u]MECHANICS IMPROVEMENTS (II)[/u][/h2][/b]

[h3][i][list]
[*]Multiple Question System
[/list][/i][/h3]

Besides normal dialogues, you’ll have the chance to ask multiple questions to some NPCs (not all), or answer them in two different ways. The enigmatic [i][b]Oraculactus[/b][/i] will be one of them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKr7456.gif[/img]

[h3][i][list]
[*]Object Picking, Throwing & Drinking Systems
[/list][/i][/h3]

We wanted NetherWorld to feel more real in terms of how Medoo interacted with items (not just clicking and adding them to inventory automatically). To do so, [b]we combined the Picking Objects System with the procedural pixel arms algorithm[/b] explained in the first update. Now Medoo can physically grab most of the objects before adding them to inventory. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q7jUYsq.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2f6V8ry.gif[/img]

[b]This led us to new and interesting functionalities[/b]. While developing Xenus boss mechanics, we created the Throwing system, so Medoo would be able to [b]handle tough objects and throw them wherever he wants.[/b] It's used in the Keranukk's boss fight too. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GBCIqiJ.gif[/img]
[i]The toughest material we found was Albert’s head, our writer and communication guy.[/i]


Finally, the [b]Drinking System was born[/b]. This would allow you to grab a beer, drink it in several sips and throw the glass on the floor.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vdWjX1P.gif[/img]
[i]"Casual" Drinking System working. Drinking minigames will have different mechanics.[/i]


[b][h2][u]GRAPHICS IMPROVEMENTS (II)[/u][/h2][/b]

[h3][i][list]
[*]Infinite Parallax
[/list][/i][/h3]

To optimize resources and time, we also developed a [b]never-ending parallax system[/b] that only generates the background needed for what’s on screen when the player is moving.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SmOZTah.gif[/img]
[i]Run all you want, Medoo… MUAHAHAHA![/i]


Regarding to Deumanville, besides the background elements we decided to [b]make visible only the on-screen grass[/b]. This has been key for properly optimization too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O0Njj0f.gif[/img]

[h3][i][list]
[*]Particles
[/list][/i][/h3]

We love realistic details, and particles like rain, gas or sand help making the scenarios feel truly alive. Adding rain to a scenario is easy with Unity, and sand too; however, recreating how these particles behave in contact with other objects is what we enjoy the most.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PPaGVqO.gif[/img]
[i]Adding sand particles to a desert house. In this case, by hand. [/i]


[b][h2][u]ONLINE FEATURES[/u][/h2][/b]

Wait... Is NetherWorld an online game? [b]Are we gonna play a Battle Royale?[/b] WTF NO. NetherWorld is still a single-player game, but we wanted to add some cool and fun online features, like worldwide leaderboards and what we call [b]the Intruders System[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BdmxwRd.gif[/img]

Imagine that you and 200 other players are getting drunk in The Puke's Saloon at the same time. Wouldn’t it be great you could see each other? 

[b]NetherWorld Intruders System[/b] is still in alpha tests, but it’s basically a [b]representation of other players in the shape of an NPC based on their in-game location[/b]. You won’t be able to interact with them, but you’ll see them in a funny (or creepy) way.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/huB4jgy.png[/img]

[h3][i][b]Aaaaand that’s it![/b][/i][/h3]
We hope you enjoyed this two-part development recap, and [b]feel free to say anything you think or wanna know about the game![/b]

[h3][i][b]...that's it?[/b][/i][/h3]
Now you are truly up-to-date Netherholics, [b]we’ll continue posting brief development updates[/b] here… We must satisfy the nosy old lady we all have inside, don't you think? 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GpqsyKO.gif[/img]


[u][h2]Wait a second...[/h2][/u]
You haven't added NetherWorld to your wishlist, or joined our Community Hub?
[b]WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420

Thanks so much and see you soon with new updates!

notes.title: Development Recap #1
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hey Netherholics![/b][/i][/h3]

It’s been 2 years since our Kickstarter campaign ended, and a lot of stuff has happened: +25 development updates, extended articles… Our backers and newsletter subscribers have already read them, but… [b]What about you?[/b] 

That’s why we’ve decided to make a [b]two-part recap update[/b] summarizing all we’ve been working on from 2018 (and before) to now. 

Once up to date, [b]we’ll continue posting brief development updates[/b] with the current progress.

[h3][b]WARNING:[/b][/h3]NetherWorld is still under development, and this is a recap. Most footage and information shown here may be outdated or may change in the future to guarantee the best quality and fun. 
[h3][b]WARNING 2:[/b][/h3]GIF compression quality is worse than in-game real footage (sorry!). 
[h3][b]WARNING 3:[/b][/h3] There are not more warnings, ENJOY! 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Okay, introduction done. Let’s start from the beginning then!

[u][h2]INTERFACE: The Menu[/h2][/u]
Here’s the Menu we designed for our first backer demo, and we actually like it for the final game. What do you think? Imagine yourself watching this while listening to NetherWorld’s main theme… Wait, you actually can listen to it in [url=https://netherworldgame.com]our website[/url]! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q6ccQ7H.gif[/img]


[h2][u]SCENARIOS (I): Deumanville[/u][/h2]

You’ll be able to explore more than 15 scenarios in NetherWorld, including exteriors and interiors. Let’s see the first one you're gonna play in: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HT9FkD0.gif[/img]

[b]Deumanville[/b] is the hometown of [i][b]Medoo[/b][/i], our unlucky black jellyfish-like main character. The green flying snot is [i][b]Bozky[/b][/i], his best friend and pet. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bIbujRy.gif[/img]

This town has changed a lot since we started its development. You’ll play it at night, but also in a beautiful sunset. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Mwbi4xr.gif[/img]

Okay, so this crazy adventure starts in Deumanville… but [b]WHO[/b] starts it?

[h3][i][list]
[*] Cubick, the cokehead mage
[/list][/i][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QOsWtyc.gif[/img]

[i][b]Cubick[/b][/i] is running away from the Mafia. Why? Don’t know yet. But what we know is that he’ll be involved in all the boss town fights... And will involve you in them, of course.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MudnuI7.gif[/img]
[i]“To the nearest drug dealer, and beyond!”[/i]


Here are some characters you’ll meet in Deumanville too. Most of them will have an important role in the story: 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3vI25DU.gif[/img]

[i][b]Yummi[/b], the party-loving newcomer. [/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sSrbZpw.gif[/img]

[i][b]Aitana[/b], the shy newcomer.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TBh23At.gif[/img]

[i][b]Roger[/b], the town bully. [/i]


[u][h2]Let's kick some asses: BOSSES (I)[/h2][/u]

We love big fights, and that’s why [b]all the enemies in NetherWorld will be deadly bosses[/b] like the pal over here:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DUS5rpp.gif[/img]

Hot armors aside, we’re glad to show you the [b]first 2 bosses you’ll have to fight in Deumanville[/b]. And you know what? You’ll have to face them [i]unarmed[/i]! MUAHAHA!

[h3][list]
[*] [i]Xenus, the Mafia Doctor[/i]
[/list][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/H1mMVEt.gif[/img]
[i]Did he drink Monster Energy or what?[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ubd14jf.gif[/img]

[h3][list]
[*] [i]Cubick Party[/i]
[/list][/h3]

There’s nothing more deadly than a party with a cokehead mage. Wait... Is that a unicorn? 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0LkEyjo.gif[/img]


[u][h2]MINIGAMES (I)[/h2][/u]
You’ll get money or materials taking part in [b]drinking competitions[/b], [b]having sex[/b] (you better don't ask with who), [b]shooting stuff[/b] or even [b]controlling a tick called Joe[/b] through filthy underground rogue-like dungeons.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9mJdwKr.gif[/img]
[i]Tick Joe in action! [WIP][/i]


[u][h2]MECHANICS IMPROVEMENTS (I): Weapons[/h2][/u]

Sword, shield, torch, shotgun, submachine gun, flamethrower… Not Pokémon games, but some of the weapons you’ll use to [strike]survive[/strike] fight bosses. Check out all the upgrades we’ve made to the weapon system below!

[list]
[*] [h3][i]Pixel Laser Sight[/i][/h3]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZePeV3n.gif[/img]
[i]Old one.[/i]


If you’ve ever worked with Unity, you’ll know how useful the [i]LineRenderer[/i] tool is for adding a laser sight like this in your weapons. The problem lies in having a cool HD red laser… in a pixel art game. We fixed it using Bresenham’s line algorithm:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rYW8dtg.gif[/img]
[i]New one.[/i]


[list]
[*] [h3][i]Procedural pixel arms[/i][/h3]
[/list]
We developed and polished a faster algorithm which allows Medoo to hold and move all kind of weapons with his pixel arms in real time. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BuZhASi.gif[/img]

If you wanna know how we did it, feel free to [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/netherworld1/news/real-time-pixel-arms]check out our IndieDB article[/url].

[list]
[*] [h3][i]“I swear I was aiming the boss!”[/i][/h3]
[/list]
At the beginning, [b]programming a realistic recoil for a jellyfish shooting a Thompson sounded fantastic.[/b] However, we didn’t take into account that two human hands were not the same as several slippery tentacles... So recoil was horrible. 

To avoid frustration and despair among players while trying to shoot a target, [b]we reduced recoil parameters[/b]. Here’s the comparison:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ajeff26.gif[/img]

[i][list]
[*] [h3]Weapon Selector[/h3]
[/list][/i]
We’re gonna kick lots of boss butts in NetherWorld, so the combat UI has to be up to scratch.
According to the mess you got into, you’ll be able to [b]switch between ranged and melee weapons[/b]. This [b]double weapon category system[/b] made difficult to decide how the weapon selector should be. We finally opted for a quarter circle in the top left corner of the screen.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mOQ3Mmc.gif[/img]

Besides showing the weapon list, its rotation would allow to change weapons and the weapon category as well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dcril0n.gif[/img]


[u][h2]GRAPHICS IMPROVEMENTS (I)[/h2][/u]

[i][h3][list]
[*] Optimization challenge
[/list][/h3][/i]
Developing NetherWorld for [b]Steam and Nintendo Switch[/b] at the same time has taught us how to work in a more efficient way, mostly in terms of [b]performance optimization[/b]. We’ve been able to reach [b]stable 60 fps[/b] even in our 300-IA-bird benchmarks! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z6kGNew.gif[/img]
[i]Hitchcock-inspired benchmark approved! [/i]


In this other image below, you'll see more than 20,000 triangles! By increasing the number of tris in each scene element, we can fit to its shape better and reduce overdraw risk.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kUgvszR.gif[/img]

This is particularly important in the game, because we love playing with illumination (and this consumes resources). 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XPUvcDn.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [i][h3]Lightning[/h3][/i]
[/list]
Although being a 2D pixel art game, we like to use different types of light and particle effects to make scenarios feel more real. To do so, we combine 2D and real-time 3D illumination.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ErMJNAY.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MBXxwb8.gif[/img]

In the second part of the update we’ll talk a bit more about how we use particles in the game. 

[list]
[*] [i][h3]Rotation system [/h3][/i]
[/list]
We considered a standard rotation would clash with the pixel art “essence” of the game, so we developed a truly [b]pixel art rotation system[/b].

That wasn’t an easy decision: NetherWorld rotation system has experienced several (and important) changes during its development. In the beginning, the calculations to build a new rotated image for big objects like the gauntlet you’ll see below raised the 30,000. After an optimization, we reduced it to 10,000.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dt62RgA.gif[/img]

We also developed a [b]system to storage the rotated images[/b], so if we already had “Object X” rotated in a certain angle, next time we needed it we'd use the stored image instead of doing the rotation calculations again.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6htFeOl.png[/img]
[i]Calculating rocktations. [/i]


[list]
[*] [i][h3]Weather system[/h3][/i]
[/list]We’ve also created a [b]Day/Night&Weather system[/b] applicable to different scenarios. Thanks to that, we’ll be able to set the perfect mood for each scenario and situation in the story!  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tIjIBs7.gif[/img]

[i][list]
[*] [h3]Outlining[/h3]
[/list][/i]
We want you to enjoy Medoo’s suffering no matter the situation, so we added some outlining when his body is hidden. Don’t miss a thing! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gfrbIpx.gif[/img]

[i][list]
[*] [h3]Blood Stain System[/h3]
[/list][/i]
There’s quite a lot of blood in NetherWorld, so we wanted it to feel right. That’s why we created a[b] 2D pixel bloodstain system[/b] that generates random bloodstains every time you hurt someone. It can be used by us (Hungry Pixel team) to decorate scenarios too, and works for dirt and other stain materials. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iR4v3IQ.gif[/img]
[i]Testing random bloodstain generator. [/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WUmuMJG.gif[/img]
[i]No difference at all![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CTEWZIS.gif[/img]
[i]Is she… hitting you with a fetus? Of course she is.[/i]


If you wanna know how we developed the Blood Stain System, [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/netherworld1/news/netherworld-pixel-bloodstain-system]we explain it here[/url]! 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][i][b]Aaaaand that’s it for now![/b][/i][/h3]
Next week we’ll finish this recap with [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/672420/view/2881697583878319506]PART 2: Desert scenario, worms, particles and more![/url][/b]

We hope you enjoyed this update as much as we did developing all this stuff. It'll be a pleasure to hear your impressions and answer any question you have about the game!

[u][h2]Wait a second...[/h2][/u]
You haven't added NetherWorld to your wishlist, or joined our Community Hub?
[b]WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420


Thanks so much and see you next week!

[b][i]Hungry Pixel team[/i][/b]
